reviews.author: Frankly Speaking
reviews.text:
The hottest Chinese restaurant in Korea right now?

Rating: 👍👍👍👍
Place: Nuwa, Sinsa-dong

Modern Cantonese Chinese dining located near Garosu-gil in Sinsa-dong. A space where Chef Eunyoung Park, formerly of Mot32 in Hong Kong, has added a modern interpretation to the solid Cantonese basics inherited from Chef Kyungrae Yeo.

Rather than simply replicating tradition, this style maintains the structure and takes the flavor to the next level. A tablet type that does not have an excessive burning taste. Oil control is neat. A type that is easy to eat as a course.

Dongpo meat dumplings are a condensed form of deeply braised meat. Bisque Mapo Tofu has a umami structure centered around a concentrated crustacean sauce. Stir-fried lamb ribs are sophisticated Chinese lamb skewers. Siregi fish stew is a menu that balances savory flavor with subtle acidity.

A natural finish to Jjambbong and Jjajangmyeon. The overall direction focuses on balance and sophistication rather than intensity. Reservation difficulty is high.

reviews.author: mygoren
reviews.text:
I finally went to Apgujeong Ruwi. Not only the Peking duck, but also the atmosphere and service were perfect. Not only did the Peking duck taste crispy on the outside and moist on the inside, but it was also fun to watch the chef skillfully prepare it right in front of my eyes. Eating duck skin lightly dipped in sugar is truly a delicacy among delicacies, so if you haven't already, you should try it. I'll regret it if I don't eat this.

The staff took care of everything I needed in advance, and the warm rooibos tea was even prepared in a warmer to keep it from getting cold, so I felt treated with great care. After the meal, I completely refreshed my mouth with a refreshing strawberry sorbet.

The luxurious yet cozy atmosphere of the hall was very nice, and the rooms were well-appointed, making it the perfect place for special family gatherings such as reunions or parents' birthdays. The entrance was full of pictures of celebrities, but it wasn't a famous place for no reason. It was even better because valet parking was convenient. I fully recognize and recommend this as a Peking Duck restaurant worth visiting on special occasions without hesitation.

reviews.text:
At the recommendation of a Chinese food lover, I visited for the first time and tried Seafood Baek Jjamppong. The broth, which is light yet rich and rich with seafood/vegetables, is rich in fresh ingredients - seafood (shrimp, octopus, squid), vegetables (bok choy, onions, etc.), mushrooms, etc. - so it's hard not to taste it.

The overall balance seems to have been achieved by maximizing the light texture with these fresh ingredients and boiling the noodles somewhat soft so that the broth soaks in well and is easy to chew. Even basic side dishes such as pickles and kimchi are not overpowering, but still deliver all the flavor they should. Although the price is a bit high at 19,000 KRW, I felt that the menu was well worth it.

As my curiosity about other menu items grows, I want to visit again soon and try various dishes.

Light but juicy? First of all, it's my first time eating pork steak, and it has a very attractive taste. It's light, yet savory and soft. It's amazing, how is it so soft(?)

reviews.author: ethan ghymn
reviews.text:
I've known about this Maddox Pizza since it first opened in Itaewon, but it felt like they were focusing on the concept, and an 18-inch XL size pizza slice (the size of a Costco pizza) costs about 6,000 won, and a pizza costs about 40,000 won. I wondered how high-quality ingredients were used to make the pizza so expensive, but I thought eating the pizza here would feel like Black Angus, so I passed it.

Then, on a recent V LIVE of the girl group Fromis_Nine, member Chae Yeong-yang was talking about the Maddox Pizza here and said that it was delicious but really salty. I prefer salty and feel a little offended by sweet ones. I have never experienced salty food when I went to an American-type restaurant where Koreans say it is salty. Instead, I felt that the seasoning was a bit boring, so I felt that it was not a temple food and that it should at least be seasoned to this level, but to a certain extent. I wondered if it was salty.

Since I had to go back after dinner, I remembered Maddox Pizza here and decided to stop by.

When I entered Maddox Pizza, hoping that it would be better than my last experience at Gino's Pizza, which was a bit pretentious and not very good, I thought it would be bigger, but it was reasonably small. After scanning the prepared pizzas, I wanted to choose between freshly baked pizzas, but the pepperoni and Hawaiian didn't look particularly good using good ingredients, and the mac and cheese, which seemed to be a popular menu, seemed to be sold at a high price for no reason, even though the ingredients of mac and cheese are cheap. Passed.

In the end, there were only three slices left, so it didn't feel like it was freshly baked, but it felt like something you don't often get at other restaurants, so I asked for one slice of red chorizo ​​with my favorite chorizo.

I tried the red chorizo ​​pizza and if I liked it, I tried some more. If not, I decided to stop by the nearby Kabadong, which I had enjoyed last time, and try Tarekatsudon again.

As I sat down, I thought that the seasonings prepared were all branded products so they didn't feel cheap and I thought they would be delivered quickly, but surprisingly they waited a while for them to be delivered.

When I picked up the pizza, it was quite hot. Instead of just bringing it to me right away, I realized that they took time to warm it up in the oven and bring it to me so that it tasted like freshly baked pizza. I think this kind of service is good.

After folding it in half and taking a bite, I did not feel the aroma or taste of chorizo ​​that I expected, but rather the feeling and taste of ragu sauce that was cooked without being soggy. The meaty taste of ragu sauce itself is familiar and okay, but the problem is that it does not have the taste of chorizo.

The chorizo ​​noodles should be salty and slightly spicy, but it tastes like Korean ragu sauce and is not salty at all, so it is said that the concept is American and the taste is a pizza tailored to the taste of Koreans.

The pizza dough doesn't taste like typical pizza dough, but rather a thin version of focaccia bread. It's moderately oily and has a lot of moisture. It's not hard or chewy at all and is crunchy and fluffy, which makes me wonder why it's called a good restaurant and has a high rating.

It was warmed in the oven and felt like it was piping hot, so I ended up eating it all and getting up from my seat with the roof of my mouth completely bare.

I stopped by a store that serves salty American pizza, so I tried a chorizo pizza that seemed a little more salty, but the pizza dough was different from the common pizza dough and had the feel of moist and fluffy focaccia bread, but it wasn't salted to suit Korean tastes, so I figured out why it was called a good restaurant. Maybe that's why the taste was different from what I expected. Only the concept was American, and the taste was tailored to Korean tastes, but it still felt like it was sold at a high price. It's okay...

These days, it's nice to see an increasing number of American pizza concept stores, but among the American pizzas I've tasted at those stores, my favorites are still PIZZAZWITATTITUDE in Apgujeong and PIZZA PIZZA By Starving Bae near Eonju Station, which uses focaccia bread-like dough similar to this restaurant.

The process of cooking the Florence wheel cheese pasta I ordered right in front of the table was interesting, and my anticipation grew from the moment I smelled the cheese. reviews.author: Heather Seung Hee Cho
reviews.text:
In conclusion, if you are looking for delicious Italian food, this is the place. And be sure to make a reservation. Have you been here for about 6 years? I told everyone that I come here every year for my birthday and anniversary (I started visiting the old attraction Italy).

✔️Atmosphere: The store has a clean and warm atmosphere. If you look at the table next to us, many people come here for blind dates or with their families. Oh! And the company gathered and rented the place. I think it's a great place when you want to treat someone that way and have a good time with others.

✔️Service: Always welcome you kindly when you visit. And one more thing I felt was that they were very attentive. The two of you are busy cooking, but in the meantime, you seem to be constantly checking the guests' tables. I didn't tell you, but if you run out of things like pickles or water, they'll come before you know it and leave them behind. When I first got hit(?), what... I was in the middle of cooking in the kitchen with my back turned. How did you know? I wondered. Haha. They are friendly and try to take care of their customers as carefully as possible, so of course I never felt that the service was lacking.

✔️Taste of food: The food that came out was also very delicious. The photos posted are all of our favorite menu items shared by two people. (We eat a bit too much haha...embarrassing) It's all delicious without any extraneous ingredients. I will write as briefly as possible.

1. Grilled eggplant: There is grilled eggplant that can only be ordered for dinner. This is really delicious. I saw someone write a review about their visit, and I saw that even people who don't like eggplant enjoyed it. I can understand it haha.

2. Raw clam oil pasta: I can’t eat shellfish because it’s salty. No, never. I don't eat it. But here, vongole is the only food I eat. The clam meat comes minced without the shell, and there is no fishy taste at all. Plus, the unique flavor of seafood was crazy.

3. Truffle Oil Mushroom Cream Fresh Noodle Pasta: Just order this without fail. It's the signature menu here and everyone's eyes widen when they take a bite of it. The truffle scent is quite strong, and the raw noodles are soft and moist. Even my boyfriend, who doesn't eat cream, gorges himself on this lol. He can eat two plates -_-...

4. Mortadella (Italian ham, not mozzarella cheese) rose barley risotto: Order it if you like risotto. I heard it was delicious in a Naver blog review, so I ordered it… Wow really haha ​​why did they order this now after 6 years of working there... I felt like I lost my life 😭

5. Steak: And if you don't order steak, it's a loss for your life. The owner here cooks the steak amazingly haha. The outside of the steak is crispy as if fried, but when you put it in your mouth, it is so soft that it melts in your mouth. The garnish that comes on the side also looks simple, but goes really well with the steak.

Even though I go to various restaurants, I don't often write reviews... but I'm writing this after going here for 6 years lol. Haha, as if I was sponsored haha. The post is long, but this is a review I bought with my own money.

reviews.author: Hyungmin Park
reviews.text:
I don't usually write reviews because it's a hassle, but it was so delicious that it's a shame I couldn't take a picture because I ate everything... I don't know about anything else, but I really liked the quality and amount of toppings and it was delicious. And the sauces that come out are all delicious. The homemade garlic sauce was especially delicious, so I ate the whole jar and even got a refill.  I tried potato pizza and pepperoni pizza, and the flaky topping sprinkled on the potato pizza was really delicious. I dipped it in garlic sauce and the moment I took a bite, my eyes seemed to have a brightness control function, and the lighting went up to 99 and I could barely control it. The signature here is the kkwari pepper bulgogi pizza, so I'll have to come again next time just because I'm curious. I had a delicious meal.

3-line summary: A restaurant that will make you write a review even if you are lazy.
The potato pizza garlic sauce is really delicious.
I want to eat again.
